text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: How did I do? Did I run well?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I was desperate to make sure I didn't
embarrass
you.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I ran well. Now then, a
reward for
giving me the chance to
debut...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Hehe! Who's a good Тренер?! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but... this is really
tugging at
my heartstrings. I'll never
forget coddling you
right now.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Let's do this again at the Classics—at the
Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I smile and nod as I watch Супер Крик
tearing up
a little.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! A photo! We need to take a
photo to
commemorate your debut.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Stand there. Okay, make sure to
smile! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
Shouldn't you be the one getting your photo
taken?

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, right. I guess that works too.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Let's take a photo together then! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
The camera captures an image of the
two of us
smiling bashfully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we need to think about what our
next race
should be.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Our goal is the Classics. If we want to
aim for
that, then...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: How about this race?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Her eyes are focused on...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Sumire Stakes. I think this is the
perfect
stepping stone towards the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
The Sumire Stakes... One would normally
choose
Satsuki Sho trial races like the
Yayoi Sho or the
Spring Stakes instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I ask if she has a particular reason for her
choice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't the name just adorable?
Sumire
flowers are so pretty.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can do my best just based on
the
name. Doesn't it make you feel
buoyant and
carefree?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Gosh, thanks for being so
understanding! That
settles it then. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
If there are any sumire flowers blooming
at the
racecourse central plaza, let's
have ourselves a
little picnic and enjoy
the view. Hehe! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I prioritize Супер Крик's feelings, and
we lock in
the Sumire Stakes for the next
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
